item.title: Update: Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa, iconic actor for Mortal Kombat's Shang Tsung, has sadly passed away at 75 years old
item.description: <p><strong>Update:</strong> Mortal Kombat co-creator Ed Boon has released a statement on Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa's passing, which has been added to our story below.</p> <p>The realm of fighting games and the world at large has lost a star who captured the hearts (and souls) of millions.</p> <p>Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa, the iconic actor for Mortal Kombat's Shang Tsung, has sadly passed away.</p>

item.title: 2XKO gives update on console release, new champion to be revealed at The Game Awards 2025 and tournament support details shared
item.description: <p><a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2xko/">2XKO</a> has been in the hands of players on PC for a few months now, and console owners may not be waiting much longer to finally jump into the action.</p> <p>Riot Games provided a few updates on 2XKO's future today including the console release, next champion reveal and official tournament support.</p>

item.title: Mortal Kombat and DC to find new home with Netflix acquisition of Warner Bros. worth over $80 billion
item.description: <p>The past few years have not been great for Warner Bros. Discovery as a whole including their gaming division, but it looks like big changes are likely on the way.</p> <p>Netflix announced today its intended deal to acquire Warner Bros., which will certainly have an impact on some of the largest fighting games around if it goes through between Mortal Kombat and Injustice.</p>

item.title: Street Fighter League Pro-US 2025 early results, stream ft. MenaRD, Xiaohai, Punk, Blaz, DualKevin, Nephew, Craime, Vxbao, Zhen, NuckleDu and more

item.title: Nounsvitational 2025 live stream ft. Zain, Cody Schwab, Hungrybox, Moky, Jmook, aMSa, Aklo, Joshman, Nicki, Krudo, lloD, Axe, Soonsay, SDJ and more
item.description: <p>The Nounsvitational is back and this time, it's not taking place stateside but is in fact happening in Tokyo, Japan.</p> <p>Players who were invited or qualified are SR|Zain, Cody Schwab, Liquid|Hungrybox, SR|Moky, FLY|Jmook, RB|aMSa, Nouns|Aklo, SR|Joshman, Nouns|Nicki, Spiral|Krudo, lloD, Tempo|Axe, Soonsay, SDJ, Trif and Goodie.</p>
